form.tokenAmountHelp: You must have held {symbol} for at least {holding} Eligibility uses your lowest balance over that window, so tokens acquired later do not count. If that balance is zero you are not eligible and your claim bond is forfeited.
form.claimBondHelp: A 10 USD8 anti-spam bond is required to file. It will not be returned if you are not eligible for a claim.
form.scoreHelp: Requested score spend. Settlement caps it to your available score, and score is spent only if an eligible payout is accepted.
form.boostersHelp: Optional. Boosters must meet the same pre-incident holding requirement as the insured token: {holding} Only eligible boosters increase payout weight and are burned on acceptance. Excess boosters are returned. Declining returns all boosters.
